cases.title: Junior Software Developer
cases.job_description: We are looking for a junior software developer to build and maintain web applications with C# and .NET. You will work with REST APIs, relational databases, testing, Git, and a collaborative development team. A relevant computer science education and willingness to learn are welcome.

cases.title: Backend Developer
cases.job_description: Our backend team develops reliable services with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL databases, authentication, authorization, and REST APIs. Experience with automated testing and Clean Architecture is valued.

cases.title: Full-Stack Developer
cases.job_description: Join a product team building responsive web experiences across frontend and backend. The role uses React, TypeScript, JavaScript, REST APIs, databases, automated testing, and containerized development.

cases.title: .NET Developer
cases.job_description: We need a .NET developer for ASP.NET Core applications, Blazor user interfaces, Entity Framework Core data access, SQL databases, authentication, and secure API development. The team follows Clean Architecture practices.

cases.title: AI / LLM Developer
cases.job_description: Build prototypes that use large language models, structured outputs, function calling, retrieval concepts, and evaluation. Python experience and reliable software engineering practices are useful. Production AI experience is not required for this junior role.

cases.title: AI Engineer / Agentic AI
cases.job_description: Develop agentic AI workflows with tool use, structured claims, guardrails, observability, failure recovery, and evaluation. Familiarity with LangGraph, OpenAI Responses API, MCP, and RAG is relevant; the role expects careful grounding and transparent limitations.

cases.title: Software Developer with RAG
cases.job_description: Help implement grounded question-answering features using embeddings, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation. Strong API development, testing, and clear evidence handling are important. Experience with large-scale search infrastructure is optional.

cases.title: Software Developer with Cloud / DevOps
cases.job_description: Work on cloud-hosted web applications and delivery automation using Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, environment configuration, and secure deployment practices. Experience with Terraform and Kubernetes is a plus, not a requirement.
